content: MLflow latest stable is 3.15.1 (Aug 2026). MLflow 3.x made models first-class (log_model(name=...) not artifact_path=...), removed Recipes/deploy server, replaced registry stages with aliases (champion/candidate) as of 2.9.0+. Client backward compatible one major version from server but same-major recommended. MinIO artifact store via MLFLOW_S3_ENDPOINT_URL + s3:// URI.
